name: Bases Multi-Row Edit
changes: New Replace list items operation. It renames one tag or list item in place on the selected notes.
Apply now skips a note when Obsidian has seen a change to its file after the preview, and names it.
tip: To rename a tag on many notes, choose Replace list items, put the old tag in Find items and the new tag in Value.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Multi-Row Edit is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases.
